description: This file defines interfaces and exceptions related to Orleans grain storage, including the IGrainStorage interface for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, as well as exception classes like InconsistentStateException.

classes.name: InconsistentStateException
classes.description: An exception thrown when there is an Etag inconsistency during a storage write operation, indicating storage or concurrency conflicts.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state data for a specific grain asynchronously.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the state data for a specific grain asynchronously.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes the state data for a specific grain asynchronously.

methods.name: DecodeException
methods.description: Decodes exception details and optionally provides extended REST error information.

methods.name: InconsistentStateException (constructors and ToString)
methods.description: Constructors initializing exception with various details, and ToString providing formatted exception info.
